description: This file provides functions for spawning and managing child processes, specifically for checking the availability of a binary and running CLI commands with timeout and output management. It includes external dependencies on Node.js 'child_process' and project-specific 'windows-spawn' modules.

methods.name: resolveCliSpawnInvocation
methods.description: Resolves the command and arguments into a spawn invocation object, considering platform and environment.

methods.name: checkQmdBinaryAvailability
methods.description: Checks if the specified binary is available by attempting to spawn it and handling timeouts and errors.

methods.name: runCliCommand
methods.description: Executes a CLI command with specified parameters, managing output size, timeouts, and error handling.
